messages.subject: BUGS Expected Means
parts: The other day people mentioned that we had expected means for all of the BUGS models.  Looking into master it looks like the BUGS models just run Stan and JAGS and then compare the results.  Do we have those values explicitly stored anywhere?  Once I have those values I'll be able to run acid tests for all of the BUGS models automatically (at least for master+ since I need the latest changes to bin/print).

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] BUGS Expected Means
parts:
We have most of the expected means for the BUGS models. For example, vol1/blocker:
src/test/models/bugs_examples/vol1/blocker/blocker_test.cpp

You'll see a block like:
  static std::vector<std::pair<int, double> >
  get_expected_values() {
    using std::make_pair;
    std::vector<std::pair<int, double> > expected_values;
    expected_values.push_back(make_pair(chains->index("d"), -0.2492));
    expected_values.push_back(make_pair(chains->index("delta_new"), -0.2499));
    expected_values.push_back(make_pair(chains->index("sigma_delta"), 0.1189));
   
    return expected_values;
  }

That's checking for d is near -0.2492, delta_new is near -0.2499, sigma_delta is near 0.1189.
